images.caption:
quotation from description on the wall:
The Cavern Wall of Fame
The "Wall of Fame" was unveiled by Gerry Marsden
on the 16th January 1997, to celebrate the 40th anniversary
of the opening of the Cavern Club.
The wall highlights the names of all the bands who appeared
at the club between 1957-1973.
Also included are some of the contemporary bands who
performed in the 90's (Oasis, Dodgy).
The Cavern Club situated on the opposite side of the road,
occupies fifty percent of the original site and proudly retains its original address of 10 MATHEW STREET. 
The Wall of Fame was conceived and financed byCavern City Tours
with support from The Beneficial Bank.

Research by Phil & Peter Thompson.

images.caption: a re-make of the Cavern.  The original was filled in to construct a rail station.  A few years later they re-built the club on more-or-less the same property.  The rumor is that the original club was not filled in but sealed off with much memorabilia left behind as a "time capsule".  John Lennon's band the "Quarrymen" played here in early 1961 with the "Beatles" doing their first gig in November 1961.— en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Cavern_Club

images.filename: The Cavern Club plaque 2 (2018-01-02 21.08.29 by Diane Griffiths).jpg
images.caption:
The Cavern Club @The Cavern Pub, Liverpool, England


               The Cavern Club
Between 1957 and 1973, most of the worlds leading artistes
played at the Cavern Club. Although synonymous with the
history of the Beatles, the Club hosted performances by the
greatest names in the history of jazz, rock, pop, blues and
soul. The club closed in 1973 only to re-open at its original
address of 10 Mathew Street (across the street from here)
in 1984. The Club, although remoselled, still atracts world-
wide media attension and   the 1990's great luminaries of
the British pop scene such as OASYS and DODGY have
performed there. The Cavern Pub and its exterior "The
Cavern Wall of Fame" is a tribute to those celebrated and
revered icons of twentieth century popular culture.

images.filename: The Cavern Club plaque 1 (2014-12-17 18.30.42 by Diane Griffiths).jpg
images.caption:
The Cavern Club @The Cavern Pub, Liverpool, England


CAVERN CLUB
1975 - 1973
The Cavern Club is obviously synonymous
with The Beatles and Merseybeat in
general, but between 1957 - 1973 most of
the giants of the rock and pop world
descended the stairs, to perform on the
stage of the most famous club in the world.
This is our tribute to those artistes
